import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long inf = 17446744073709551616L;
    static long[][] dp = new long[18][250005];
    static long[] fact = new long[250005];
    static long[] inv_fact = new long[250005];
    static long N, K, M;

    static long fast_pow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1L;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1L) == 1L) res = (res * base) % M;
            base = (base * base) % M;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long nCr(int a, int b) {
        return (((fact[a] * inv_fact[b]) % M) * inv_fact[a - b]) % M;
    }

    static long solve() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % M;
        }
        inv_fact[(int) N] = fast_pow(fact[(int) N], M - 2);
        for (int i = (int) N - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv_fact[i] = (inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % M;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            dp[1][i] = inv_fact[i];
        }
        long res = (dp[1][(int) N] * nCr((int) K, 1)) % M;
        int t = (int) Math.min(17, K);
        for (int i = 2; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int j = (int) N; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & (int) N) {
                for (int l = j; l > 0; l = (l - 1) & j) {
                    dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j ^ l] * inv_fact[l];
                    if (dp[i][j] > inf) dp[i][j] %= M;
                }
                dp[i][j] %= M;
            }
            res += dp[i][(int) N] * nCr(K, i);
            res %= M;
        }
        res = (res * fact[(int) N]) % M;
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();
        M = sc.nextLong();
        long answer = fast_pow(K, N);
        if ((N & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(answer);
        } else {
            answer = (answer - solve() + M) % M;
            System.out.println(answer);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
